title: Business Support Co-ordinator
description:
Business Support Co-ordinator

Join the Team at Gaskells (North West) Ltd

Are you highly organised, customer-focused and thrive in a fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy solving problems, building relationships and supporting a busy sales team? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Business Support Co-ordinator to join our growing team and play a key role in delivering excellent customer service, supporting our Business Development Managers and ensuring our customers receive a seamless experience. The role focuses on contract processing, supply chain support and customer excellence.

About the Role

As a Business Support Co-ordinator, you'll be the link between our customers, sales team and supply chain partners. You'll help manage customer contracts, resolve service issues, coordinate subcontracted services and ensure every customer receives an outstanding level of support.

No two days are the same, so we're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and is passionate about delivering great service.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide exceptional customer service via telephone and email.
- Support Business Development Managers with customer enquiries, contracts and day-to-day administration.
- Process contracts accurately and efficiently.
- Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers and colleagues.
- Resolve customer and subcontractor service issues quickly and professionally.
- Ensure subcontracted services are delivered smoothly and in line with customer expectations.
- Use business systems including CRM, Microsoft Office and reporting software to maintain accurate records.
- Provide contract information and support to the sales team.
- Ensure customer solutions comply with environmental, safety and regulatory requirements.
- Support continuous improvement within the Business Support function.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:
- Customer focused with an excellent telephone manner.
- Positive, resilient and confident.
- Adaptable with a willingness to learn.
- A natural problem solver who can think on their feet.
- Organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Calm under pressure and able to manage competing priorities.
- Professional with strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent customer communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills.
- Strong conflict resolution and problem-solving abilities.
- Good PC skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Ability to negotiate and build lasting customer relationships.

Desirable
- Experience using CRM or sales management systems.
- Experience within the waste management or environmental sector.
- Knowledge of sustainability or environmental legislation.
- Advanced interpersonal and communication skills.

Why Join Gaskells?

At Gaskells, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service while creating a supportive and professional working environment. We value:

Teamwork

Customer excellence

Professionalism

Honesty and integrity

Continuous learning and development

Respect for colleagues and the environment

Apply Today

If you're looking for an opportunity where your organisational skills, customer service expertise and positive attitude can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a team that's committed to delivering outstanding service every day.

Please include your CV and a short covering email explaining why you would be a great fit for the Business Support Co-ordinator role.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
Job Title: Complaints Handler
Contract Type: Fixed term for 6 months
Salary: £33,723.55 (£37,101.56 is achieved after 12 months successful performance in the role)
Working Hours: 35 hours per week
Working Pattern: Monday to Friday- Hybrid
Location: Speke, Liverpool

If you share our values and are excited about making a significant impact at Riverside, please ensure you attach a current CV and covering letter. At Riverside we recruit to potential not just on skills and experience, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the essential criteria on the job description.
Please note that whilst we will accept applications based on any form of valid legal permission to work in the UK, we will be surrendering the Riverside Sponsorship licence, so for the avoidance of doubt, we are unable to apply for any further sponsorships whether on behalf of existing colleagues or candidates.

The difference you will make as a Complaints Handler
You will provide a professional, responsive and positive feedback and complaint resolution service to customers, ensuring an empathetic approach at the point of contact, to deliver a customer centred approach to the handling of feedback and complaint resolution. You will have individual autonomy and freedom to solve customer problems and provide responsive, supportive and thorough investigations to all feedback and complaints, ensuring all investigations are in line with the appropriate policy and procedures that are in place. Develop performance information, insights and understanding into the causes for customer feedback and identify areas for improvement based on learning, and work closely with the Heads of Services to identify service improvements as a result of customer feedback.

About you
We are looking for someone with
- Clear demonstrable experience in Complaints Handling
- An empathic approach to dealing with customers.
- Strong analytical and investigation skills
- Excellent planning and organisational skills.

Why Riverside?
At Riverside, we're a housing association with a difference - enhancing the everyday for all our customers. For 90 years, we've been revitalising neighbourhoods and supporting communities by providing the homes they need to live full, fulfilling and rewarding lives.
We have a portfolio of over 75,000 affordable residential and retirement homes across the UK. Our work ranges from homelessness services to social care, employment support to retirement living, and we need the best people on board to help us.

Working with us, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive pay & generous pension
- 28 days holidays plus bank holidays
- Flexible working options available
- Investment in your learning, personal development and technology
- A wide range of benefits

Diversity and Inclusion at Riverside:
We are inclusive. At Riverside, we value diversity in all its forms. We foster a workplace where all individuals are respected, empowered, and heard. Our commitment to inclusivity drives our success and enriches the lives of our customers and colleagues.
Riverside is a Disability Confident Employer and operates a Guaranteed Interview Scheme for any applicant who declares they have a disability. If the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the role (as set out in the role profile and/or person specification) they will be guaranteed an interview.
Applications may close before the deadline, so please apply early to avoid disappointment.

title: Events Administrator
description:
Job Title: Events Administrator

Location: Liverpool Street, London
Pay: 14-16 per hour

Duration: 2 months minimum
Hours: Monday-Friday, 37.5-40 hours per week
Start Date: ASAP

What you'll be doing
- Manage and respond to enquiries received through the shared Events inbox.
- Process event bookings and maintain accurate event records and attendee data.
- Support the preparation and packing of event materials prior to events.
- Unpack, organise, and reconcile materials following events.
- Conduct regular stock checks and maintain inventory records.
- Coordinate courier bookings and liaise with delivery providers regarding event logistics.
- Arrange and manage event printing requirements.
- Create event collateral, including posters, speaker cards, signage, and delegate materials.
- Set up event surveys and assist with compiling post-event reports.
- Collect printed materials from suppliers and carry out quality and accuracy checks.
- Proofread event communications and printed materials.
- Provide basic marketing and promotional support for events.
- Assist the wider Events Team with day-to-day administration and coordination activities.
- Undertake additional ad hoc administrative duties as required.

What you'll bring
- Previous experience within events administration, events coordination, office administration, or marketing support.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to manage multiple priorities and work effectively to deadlines.
- A confident communicator, both written and verbal.
- Comfortable liaising with suppliers, couriers, colleagues, and external stakeholders.
- Proactive, reliable, and capable of working independently.
- Flexible and willing to support hands-on event preparation activities.
- A collaborative team player with a positive and adaptable approach.
- Competent in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
- Experienced in working with spreadsheets, databases, and administrative systems.
- Confident producing accurate written communications and proofreading documents
- Experience supporting event logistics and delivery.
- Knowledge of booking systems, CRM systems, or event management platforms would be advantageous.

title: Part Time Receptionist
description:
Join Our Team as a Part Time Receptionist

Are you a friendly and reliable individual with a passion for helping others? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where every day brings new challenges? If so, we want YOU to join our team as a Receptionist

Position Details:
- Contract Type: Temporary until December
- Hours: 21 hours per week - you will have to be able to work between Monday to Friday- 8am-5pm
- Pay: £13.59
- Location: Liverpool

About the Role:
As a Receptionist, you will be a key player in providing exceptional support . Your role will be diverse and rewarding, ensuring that visitors, colleagues, and customers receive the highest level of service. You will be the friendly face that greets visitors, assists with conference facilities, and keeps the reception running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:

What You'll Do:
As the first point of contact for visitors, you will play a vital role in creating a welcoming atmosphere. Your responsibilities will include:
- Greet & Welcome Visitors: Provide a warm and professional welcome to all guests, ensuring they feel valued and supported.
- Assist with Enquiries: Handle queries both over the phone and face-to-face, ensuring prompt and effective communication.
- Operate the Switchboard: Manage incoming calls and sort mail with professionalism and efficiency.
- Security Procedures: Adhere to security protocols by issuing passes and monitoring visitors using CCTV.
- Basic Administration Duties:
- Conduct stock takes of provisions
- Handle printing, photocopying, binding, laminating, and shredding tasks
- Produce certificates as required
- Manage Conference Facilities: Utilise White space software to coordinate meeting spaces.
- Document Preparation: Use Excel and Word to create and manage documents.
- Maintain Stock Levels: Ensure the stationery cupboard is well stocked and organised.
- Work to Deadlines: Prioritise tasks effectively to meet deadlines.
- Additional Duties: Undertake other responsibilities, aligned with your grade.

About You:
We're on the lookout for a someone who:
- Has outstanding customer service and communication skills.
- Is confident in interacting with visitors, colleagues, and external stakeholders.
- Is organised, reliable, and adept at managing multiple tasks.
- Works brilliantly both independently and as part of a team.
- Exudes a positive, professional, and helpful attitude.
- Is comfortable using Microsoft Office applications and general office equipment.
- Takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Why Join Us?
- Be part of a vibrant team dedicated to making a difference in the community!
- Work in a supportive atmosphere where your contributions are valued.

If you are ready to take on this rewarding role and make a positive impact in the government and public sector, we want to hear from you!

Apply Now!
Join us in creating a welcoming and efficient environment for everyone who walks through our doors. Submit your application today and let's make a difference together!

title: Receptionist
description: Valley Medical Centre is a busy and well-established GP practice based in Childwall, Liverpool, and is part of the Childwall & Wavertree Primary Care Network (PCN) . We are committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care and are seeking a friendly, professional, and organised Receptionist to join our team. This is a busy and rewarding role that requires excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to remain calm and professional when working under pressure. The ideal candidate will be patient-focused, reliable, and able to work effectively as part of a supportive team whilst maintaining confidentiality at all times. Working at Valley Medical Centre offers the opportunity to be part of a dedicated team that is passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare services to the local community. We provide a welcoming and supportive working environment with opportunities for training and development As a Receptionist at Valley Medical Centre, you will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing a welcoming, professional, and efficient service. You will be responsible for managing appointment bookings, handling telephone enquiries, processing patient requests, and undertaking a range of administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. The role requires excellent communication, customer service, and organisational skills, with the ability to work effectively in a busy primary care environment. The Receptionist is the first point of contact for patients and visitors attending Valley Medical Centre. The post holder will provide a professional, courteous, and efficient reception and administrative service, ensuring patients receive a high standard of customer care at all times. The role requires excellent communication and organisational skills, the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality. The Receptionist will support the smooth day-to-day running of the practice by undertaking a variety of reception and administrative duties.

title: Receptionist
description: Anfield Group Practice is looking for a Receptionist/Administrator to work in our friendly, extremely busy GP surgery. The contract is permanent Hours of work would be within our practice opening hours being Monday 1.30pm to 6.30pm, Tuesday 1.30pm - 8.00pm, (minus 30 mins unpaid break) Wednesday 12.30pm - 6.30pm Thursday 2.00pm - 6.30pm and Friday 2.00pm - 6.30pm Occasional Saturday mornings (optional) The successful candidate will be highly motivated, confident, enthusiastic, can answer telephones in a professional and courteous manner, with excellent communication, listening and administration skills. The candidate would also require excellent keyboard skills. You will project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, whether in person, via the telephone, emails or online. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines Process and recording information in accordance with practice procedures and scanning of clinical documents. When dealing with patients, you must be polite, compassionate and discrete. The following are the core responsibilities of the Receptionist. There may be on occasion a requirement to carry out other tasks. This will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels. These duties include - - Maintain and monitor the practice appointment system - Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments - Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the patients' request appropriately - Signpost patients to the correct service using our new care navigation tool - Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies - Photocopy documentation as required - Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required - Input data onto healthcare records as necessary - Direct requests for information, i.e., SAR, insurance/solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the administrative team - Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner - Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times - Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards - Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested - Monitor stationery supplies and advise restocking orders - Ensure repeat prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently - Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary
